section.name: DavMail RoadMap
section.p: Since EWS deprecation by Microsoft in September 2026, focus is on Graph backend completion for current releases. EWS remains available for on prem Exchange and Office 365 tenants where EWSEnabled is forced to true.
The following section lists the expected new features and enhancements in next DavMail versions.

ul.li: Bugfix release, fix reported bugs on new Graph backend
Review and implement user requested enhancements
Deprecate WebDAV backend (not in use since Exchange 2003), remove in 8.0.0

p.strong: Features that may be implemented, but are not yet planned

ul.li: Exhange Online Archive support, pending graph support

p.strong: Features that will not be implemented for various reasons, from limited resources to impossible to implement

ul.li: Implement EWS frontend for Exchange 2003 backend and Outlook 2011
